text: 这问题很简单，每个人（无论男女）都有自己婚恋的巅峰期和低谷期。
en: This question is very simple: everyone, regardless of gender, has their own peak and trough periods in romance and marriage.

text: 低谷的时候苟一点，巅峰的时候多选选，这些都是人之常情。
en: When in a trough, settle for a bit less; when at a peak, take your time choosing — these are only human nature.

text: 但问题是，很多女生会一直认为自己处于巅峰期，且越来越巅峰。
en: But the problem is that many women keep believing they are at their peak, and becoming ever more so.

text: 这就自欺欺人了。
en: That is simply self-deception.

text: 從性的生理狀態來說
en: From the physiological perspective of sex,

text: 只要男的功能是正常的，都會希望對方越年輕越好
en: As long as a man's functions are normal, he will want the other party to be as young as possible.

text: 這是刻在Dna裡面的
en: This is etched into the DNA.

text: 畢竟不管是3秒還是3公分
en: After all, whether it is three seconds or three centimetres,

text: 都會有一股多巴胺充腦門
en: there will be a surge of dopamine flooding the brain.

text: 而女性而言，可能從來沒有舒服過
en: As for women, they may never have experienced pleasure.

text: 這可能是之前經驗是3秒或是3公分
en: This may be because their previous experience was three seconds or three centimetres.

text: 不管怎麼說
en: No matter what,

text: 如果一個女人到40歲從來就沒有從性感覺愉悅
en: If a woman reaches forty and has never experienced sexual pleasure,

text: 覺得不需要男人也是可以理解的
en: it is understandable that she feels she does not need a man.

text: 因为40岁的男的还能生，40岁的女的基本生不了了。
en: Because a forty-year-old man can still have children, whereas a forty-year-old woman essentially cannot.

text: 出于本能，除非超级大美女，否则几乎不考虑。
en: Out of instinct, unless she is a stunning beauty, he will hardly consider it.

text: 男人40一枝花，女人40豆腐渣，为什么有这样的说法呢？
en: A man of forty is a flower, a woman of forty is bean curd dregs — why is there such a saying?

text: 我总结以下几个方面。
en: I summarise the following points.

text: 第一，生理上来讲，女人生理成熟本身就比男人快，所以，从小到大女的总是比男的早成熟。
en: First, physiologically speaking, women's physical maturation is itself faster than men's, so from childhood to adulthood women always mature earlier than men.

text: 到了40岁以后的女性，如果保养不是很好的话，生理机能退化的非常的快，最明显就是绝经，绝经就生不了娃。
en: For women past forty, if they have not looked after themselves well, their physiological functions decline very rapidly; the most obvious sign is menopause, and with menopause they can no longer have children.

text: 你说有几个男人愿意取。
en: Tell me, how many men would be willing to marry such a woman.

text: 而且，男性40岁正是身体的黄金阶段，他们要取首要考虑的是，比自己小的，除非家庭条件不理想的，才会考虑和自己同岁或大的。
en: Moreover, a man at forty is in the golden stage of his physique; when he looks to marry, his primary consideration is someone younger than himself, and only if his family circumstances are less than ideal would he consider someone of the same age or older.

text: 第二，事业的成熟，40岁左右的男性到了这个年龄，有一定的物质基础，或是事业上有所小成，他们更不可能去取一个比自己小的，即使对方条件优越自己。
en: Second, career maturity: men around forty, having reached this age, have a certain material foundation or some modest success in their careers, and they are even less likely to marry someone younger than themselves, even if the other party's circumstances are superior to their own.

text: 第三，生娃娃，四十多岁的男人结婚，大部分人依旧是传宗接代，能有个自己的宝宝。
en: Third, having children: when a man in his forties marries, most still wish to carry on the family line and have a child of their own.

text: 但40岁以后的女人，生宝宝的风险是非常大的，所以，40男性从心底就不会找，与自己年龄相仿的女性。
en: But for a woman past forty, the risk of having a baby is very great, so a man in his forties will, at heart, not seek a woman of a similar age.

text: 总的来讲，40岁男性为什么不考虑女40岁的根本原因，还是在生育上多些。
en: Overall, the fundamental reason why a forty-year-old man will not consider a forty-year-old woman still comes down chiefly to childbearing.

text: 作为40+的中年妇女表示很吃惊，明明有些男性答主很认真地分享了现实情况，为什么会被批得体无完肤呢？
en: As a middle-aged woman in my forties, I am quite surprised: some male respondents clearly shared the reality in all seriousness, so why were they torn to shreds?

text: 其实40岁的女人应该再往上考虑50+的男人。
en: Actually, a forty-year-old woman should look higher and consider men in their fifties and above.

text: 那个年代出生的人遇到的时代机遇好不内卷，哪怕再普通的人只要不赌不嫖三观正有房有车还是非常容易的。
en: People born in that era encountered good opportunities and were not caught up in cut-throat competition; even the most ordinary person, so long as they did not gamble or frequent prostitutes, held sound values, and owned a home and a car, could still get by very easily.

text: 很多人贷款也还清了，辛苦了一辈子也值得吃喝玩乐放松一下，找这样的伴侣其乐融融不是蛮好的？
en: Many have paid off their mortgages, and having toiled all their lives they deserve to enjoy themselves and relax; is it not rather nice to find such a partner and live in perfect harmony?

text: 而40岁的男人还处于奋斗期，条件好的自恃甚高总幻想还能找到更年轻的。
en: A forty-year-old man, by contrast, is still in his striving years; those in good circumstances are full of self-importance and always fantasise that they can still find someone younger.

text: 关于这一点也不知道为什么惹得很多姑娘不高兴了，永远喜欢更年轻的不是动物的本能么？
en: I do not know why this point angered so many young women; is not always preferring the younger one simply an animal instinct?

text: 难道有二胎的家庭不基本上都喜欢更小的孩子吗？
en: Do families with a second child not, by and large, favour the younger child?

text: 其实女人也一样喜欢年轻的。
en: Actually, women too prefer the younger ones.

text: 但是一想到小鲜肉过几年也会变成大叔，还不如直接找小有累积成就的大叔。
en: But the moment one thinks that a fresh-faced young man will in a few years also turn into a middle-aged man, it is better to go straight for a mature man who has already built up some accomplishment.

text: 现在某书上流行的中年妇女找小鲜肉结婚生子，除了赚流量的可以视为搞事业，剩下的博主包括热烈捧场的粉丝们毫不客气地说都是脑残。
en: Nowadays, the trend on a certain platform of middle-aged women marrying fresh-faced young men and having children — apart from those who are merely chasing traffic and can be regarded as building a career, the rest of the bloggers, including their ardently cheering fans, are, to put it bluntly, utterly idiotic.

text: 她们总是认为吸引小鲜肉的靠的是屹立不倒的美貌+优秀的条件，简单地翻译过来就是整容化妆美颜+有钱，而核心条件其实只是有钱。
en: They always believe that attracting a fresh-faced young man relies on unfading beauty plus excellent circumstances; translated plainly, that means cosmetic surgery, make-up and beauty filters plus money — yet the core requirement is in fact simply money.

text: 如果没有钱，前面的一切条件都没用。
en: Without money, none of the above conditions are of any use.

text: 当然我也碰到过吹嘘小鲜肉给她花钱的。
en: Of course, I have also come across those who boast that a fresh-faced young man spends money on them.

text: 根据我的了解可能是此人一直伪装成家境优越的假象，让小鲜肉误以为付出一些可以吊到大鱼少奋斗好些年。
en: From what I understand, this person has always put on a false front of coming from a wealthy family, leading the fresh-faced young man to mistakenly believe that by investing a little he can land a big catch and save himself years of striving.

text: 嗯总之也不会长久的。
en: Well, in any case it will not last.

text: 有些人会说我有钱有实力愿意花，诚然个人选择没啥好喷的。
en: Some will say, 'I have money and means and am willing to spend it' — and to be fair, it is a personal choice and there is nothing to criticise.

text: 但是你的钱不是辛苦赚来的吗，或者天生继承父母的钱难道他们不是辛苦赚来的吗？
en: But was your money not earned through hard work? Or even if you inherited it from your parents at birth, was it not they who earned it through hard work?

text: 当然还是价值观的不同，无法理解。
en: Of course, it comes down to a difference in values, which I cannot understand.

text: 有些女性表面上很潇洒，扬言只在意过程不在乎结果，而真正最后能做到的实在是凤毛麟角。
en: Some women appear wonderfully carefree on the surface, declaring that they care only about the process and not the outcome, yet those who truly manage this in the end are few and far between.

text: 回到这个题目本身还是国内女性普遍自恃受害者心态，所以特别激动破防了吧？
en: Coming back to the question itself, it is still that women in China generally adopt a victim mentality, which is why they got so agitated and defensive, is it not?

text: 在我看来作为40+的女性，我是不会找同龄的男性的。
en: In my view, as a woman in her forties, I would not look for a man of the same age.

text: 其实他们一边爱找年轻的女孩，一边又担心别人只看中他们的钱，贴上物质的标签，神经兮兮的也难伺候。
en: Actually, on the one hand they love pursuing young girls, while on the other they worry that others only value their money and label them as materialistic; they are so neurotic that they are difficult to please.

text: 当然以上指的是至少到了四五十岁还有一份体面工作、有基本房车条件的男人，否则也连讨论门槛的条件也达不到吧？
en: Of course, the above refers to men who are at least in their forties or fifties, still hold a decent job, and meet the basic requirements of owning a home and a car; otherwise they would not even clear the threshold for discussion, would they?

text: 最后考虑到前面的话会得罪女拳同胞们特此说明一下，我只是在论证事实即“40+的男人肯定更喜欢年轻的女性”，存在并不代表这个现象是合理的，但它确实存在。
en: Finally, aware that what I said earlier might offend my feminist compatriots, let me make it clear: I am merely demonstrating the fact that 'men over forty certainly prefer younger women'. That it exists does not mean the phenomenon is reasonable, but it does exist.

text: 曾经在别的类似帖子下有人抨击说我思想封建，实在是逻辑混乱。
en: Elsewhere, under a similar post, someone attacked me by calling my thinking feudal — that is simply a muddle of logic.

text: 你在日常生活中没见过不合理的现象吗？
en: Have you never encountered unreasonable phenomena in everyday life?

text: 讨论现象的存在难道等同于认可其合理性？
en: Does discussing the existence of a phenomenon amount to endorsing its reasonableness?

text: 另外也不用怀疑我是嫉妒同龄优秀女性依旧保持美貌，我虽然从来不整容，但那些博主有本事也别整别化妆来关掉滤镜，还未必比得过。
en: Nor should you suspect that I am jealous of accomplished women my own age who still retain their beauty; although I have never had cosmetic surgery, those bloggers, if they have the nerve, should also stop having surgery and wearing make-up and turn off their filters — and might well not measure up.

text: 至于身材么，我看有些P得周围环境都变形了也就那样，不明白一群粉丝在激动什么，估计是实在是没开过什么眼界。
en: As for their figures, I see some who are so heavily photoshopped that even the surroundings are distorted, and that is all there is to it; I cannot understand what a crowd of fans are getting excited about — presumably they have simply never broadened their horizons.

text: 说到底，女性还是应该自尊自信，少活在网络的虚幻世界里，用心经营好自己的现实生活。
en: In the final analysis, women should still be self-respecting and self-confident, live less in the illusory world of the internet, and tend to their real lives with care.

text: 很简单，四十岁的女人都已经进入更年期了，我们知道四十岁的女人进入更年期有多么可怕，她会不断的折磨你。
en: It is simple: a woman of forty has already entered menopause, and we know how dreadful it is when a forty-year-old woman goes through menopause — she will torment you ceaselessly.

text: 其实她心里也不知道为什么，但是她就是喜欢折磨人，让男人无法理喻。
en: Actually, even she does not know why in her heart, but she simply enjoys tormenting others, leaving men unable to make sense of her.

text: 这个时候如果那个男人没结婚，除非他特别穷，没有能力养老婆，只要稍微有一点点钱的人都不考虑娶这样的老婆
en: At this point, if that man is unmarried, unless he is utterly destitute and unable to support a wife, anyone with even the slightest bit of money would not consider taking such a woman as his wife.

text: 第二点，男性在四十岁的男性和四十岁岁的女性，其实生活的压力男性比女性更大。
en: Second, for a man of forty and a woman of forty, in fact the pressures of life weigh more heavily on the man than on the woman.

text: 这时候如果你娶了一个处在更年期，出在性格最不好的年龄的时候的女人为妻，你可以想象到你婚后的生活会是怎样的，那简直就是地狱。
en: If at this stage you were to take as your wife a woman going through menopause, at the age when her temperament is at its worst, you can imagine what married life would be like — it would be sheer hell.

text: 除非你有有超强的忍耐力，或者你有其他的办法能能够逃避这一切。
en: Unless you possess extraordinary endurance, or you have some other means of escaping all of this.

text: 第三点，四十岁的女性处于性欲的高峰期，而这个时候四十岁的男性已经有心无力的下坡路了。
en: Third, a woman of forty is at the peak of her sexual desire, whereas a man of forty is already on the downhill slope, willing in spirit but failing in strength.

text: 这个时候你要取一个四十岁的女性为妻的话，我可以告诉你，你晚上除了咒骂你的时候，就是你要不停的运动。
en: If you were to take a forty-year-old woman as your wife at this time, I can tell you that your nights would consist of nothing but her cursing you and your having to keep moving all the time.

text: 这个时候有可能四十岁男人和四十岁女人结婚以后，男性的寿命和身体健康会直线下降。
en: At this point it is possible that, after a forty-year-old man marries a forty-year-old woman, the man's lifespan and physical health will decline precipitously.

text: 所以说综上所述，四十岁的男人不会娶四十岁的女人，除非自己非常穷，那个女人非常富裕，其他的时候不会考虑。
en: Therefore, to sum up, a man of forty will not marry a woman of forty, unless he himself is extremely poor and that woman is very wealthy; at any other time he would not consider it.
